Notices for the libraries that are bundled inside index.js (WebLLM 0.2.85)

WebLLM's own licence (Apache License 2.0) is in the file LICENSE next to this one. The file index.js is the unchanged
build that the WebLLM project publishes. Its text keeps the notices of the code that is built into it:

  - The Apache TVM web runtime (The Apache Software Foundation), Apache License 2.0. Notice kept in the file.
    Full licence text: ../../licenses/Apache-2.0.txt
  - Types and helper code from the OpenAI Node.js library ("Copyright 2024 OpenAI"), Apache License 2.0.
    Notice kept in the file. Full licence text: ../../licenses/Apache-2.0.txt
  - tslib ("Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation"), Zero-Clause BSD licence. Notice kept in the file.
  - loglevel, MIT licence, text below.

The tokenizer and grammar tools that WebLLM uses (web-tokenizers, XGrammar) are released under the Apache License 2.0.
